devtools.tests.screen reconstructs the current editor screen as text by
reading window positions, borders, and buffer contents into a character grid.
This is the closest analog to a Selenium screenshot that works in
nvim --headless test runs. Include tests and demonstrate it in the
notify e2e test to eyeball the notification box at the moment it shows.

Also added vertical split regression test for split right behavior

returns no row/col/width/height. Query them via nvim_win_get_position,
